description:
fastwrite is an AI writing assistant help you writing your assignments, Bachelor's or Master's thesis or papers.

This connector gives ChatGPT access to your fastwrite source library, so you can work with your own literature directly in ChatGPT.

To supercharge your ChatGPT, you can upload your academic sources and enable it to:

- Chat with your library to get an overview
- Search your sources for specific information
- Back its claims with verified citation links
- Discover new literature beyond your own library through our paper database with 20 million papers
- Search the web for further relevant papers

Get started: create your free fastwrite account, upload your literature and connect your sources to ChatGPT!

defaultPrompt: Search for papers that support my claim that homeoffice can lead to productivity gains!
In my literature, find information on Modigliani's & Miller's theorem.
Which academic sources am I missing for my academic work? Search new ones!
